text:
Nora: Who wants a quick scone run? there's a new bakery on 11th. thinking blueberry + one GF almond-free.
Malik: yes please. blueberry for me. I'll trade two km of code review for crumbs.
Tasha: GF almond-free for me too. also FYI someone nuked the fish stew in the microwave yesterday at 7pm. microwaves are sacred.
Nora: noted. I'll avoid the 7pm fish slot. anyone allergic to blueberries?
Omar: allergic to bees (??) so blueberry is fine. but no cross-contamination with almonds pls.
KitchenBot: Inventory alert: communal sugar 0.5, stirring spoons 2, napkins 10. Suggested: scone trays 6, napkins 1 pack.
DevOpsBot: deploy finished: kitchen-sensors v2.0. Now tracks 'mystery-smell' events and posts to #eng-oncall.
Malik: awesome. can you also check for that jumbo coffee pod box? running on fumes.
Nora: adding 20-count coffee pods, 2 blueberry scones, 1 GF almond-free scone, napkins. ETA 25.
Tasha: I'll grab the 'microwave etiquette' poster and tape it on the machine after lunch.
--- 30 minutes later ---
Nora: back. Score: bakery had only one GF left (grilled to perfection), bought extra napkins and a box of pods. left receipt on the fridge.
Omar: pics? :camera_with_flash:
Nora: pic uploaded to #random. also left a sticky: 'please don't reheat tuna in here' on the microwave.
Malik: Venmo me $3.75 for my scone @Malik.
Tasha: Sent $4.10 for GF and napkins.
Omar: Sent $3.75.
KitchenBot: Expense logged: Nora reimbursed $18.60. Entry: team-expenses/2026-05.
DevOpsBot: kitchen-sensors detected 'mystery-smell' at 2026-05-12T19:01:22Z. Alert routed to #eng-oncall.
Nora: Good work team. Also labeled the GF scone with 'GF - no nuts' and put a tiny flag in the tin.
Tasha: Poster up. Peace in the microwave.
Malik: Snack karma restored. Next mission: cookie diplomacy?
